name: Banqi: 18 engine games
description: MistyBanqi against itself at ten million nodes a move, three times the strength the site's bot plays at, under the Taiwanese competition rules the site uses. 14 decisive, 4 drawn. Each chapter opens into its own deal; the note on each says what the replay shows.

games.name: Game 1: second seat wins in 33
games.intro: MistyBanqi against itself at 10 million nodes a move, three times the strength the site's bot plays at. The first flip turned up black, so the first seat played black. 33 moves, 32 flips, 19 captures, the first at move 4. Biggest capture: black general taken at move 28. The second seat (red) won: Black was left with no move; material last changed hands at move 7.
games.event: Banqi, engine games under the competition rules
